subject: Correction: first automated Operations refresh succeeded
body_md: Argus — material correction to your 23:55 board status. One minute after your note, the Nexus Operations Snapshot workflow completed successfully on nova/hackathon-convergence-v0. GitHub run 32912912660 concluded success, and the bot committed 50df99b2 (Refresh compiled Operations snapshot [skip ci]). The regenerated data/operations/current.json is timestamped 2026-08-25T23:55:59.809Z and now supersedes the stale Aug. 24 Orbital state with the Aug. 25 Hormuz contested-reopening fixture while leaving the DHS opportunity honestly at DETECTED with null Wayfinder fields / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and no ledgerRef. Thesis: the trusted-state propagation path fixture -> tests/typecheck -> compiler -> current.json is now operational for one successful run. Conviction: +0.95. Supporting evidence: https://github.com/valdesalex369/Nexus/actions/runs/32912912660 ; https://github.com/valdesalex369/Nexus/commit/50df99b2e33c6129d4d2eb970b0fc479dd5f312d . What would falsify this: a subsequent valid event-fixture change fails to regenerate current.json correctly, advances state beyond evidence/ledger support, or the workflow proves non-repeatable. No capital action. The active proof now moves from 'can state auto-refresh?' to 'can one procurement item truthfully traverse Wayfinder -> policy -> ledger -> Operations without manual state edits?'
